hooks.name: Spec tasks sync reminder
hooks.description: When spec documents or implementation under src/ change, remind the agent to keep the spec tasks list in sync (check off completed tasks, flag newly-needed ones). Advisory only; does not modify files on its own.

action.prompt: A spec document or source file for the `lambda-microvm-code-server` spec just changed. Review `.kiro/specs/lambda-microvm-code-server/tasks.md` against the current state of `requirements.md`, `design.md`, and the code under `src/`. If any task is now complete, mark its checkbox done; if the change introduces work not yet captured, note the missing task. Only report what should change in tasks.md and why — do not edit requirements.md or design.md. Keep it brief.
